name: Fetch.ai
rootCause: An attacker used a leaked conversion-authorizer / bridge backend signing key to call conversionIn() on Fetch.ai’s Ethereum token-conversion contract and drain about 8,721,530 FET (~$1.53 million). The same wallet cluster then minted about 408.5 million unauthorized NTX via a NuNet deployer key and later expanded the attack to related ASI Alliance bridge/converter infrastructure.
